title: Birla Mandir Delhi - Timings, History & Travel Guide
content:
Birla Mandir Delhi – Timings, History & Travel Guide,

Birla Mandir, also known as Laxminarayan Temple, is one of the most beautiful and popular temples in Delhi. Dedicated to Lord Vishnu (Laxminarayan) and Goddess Lakshmi, this temple is not just a place of worship but also a peaceful retreat in the busy heart of the city.

Built in 1939 by the famous Birla family and inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi, the temple is a stunning example of modern Hindu architecture. Its red and white sandstone structure, tall shikharas (spires), and intricate carvings make it a must-visit landmark. The temple complex also has shrines dedicated to Lord Shiva, Krishna, and Buddha, giving it a unique spiritual touch.

Special Highlight: Birla Mandir becomes especially vibrant during Janmashtami and Diwali, when it is beautifully decorated with lights and flowers. These festivals attract thousands of devotees who come to witness the grand celebrations.

Best Time to Visit: The temple can be visited throughout the year, but the best time is from October to March, when the weather is pleasant. Birla Mandir is open daily from 4:30 AM to 1:30 PM and from 2:30 PM to 9:00 PM.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest station is Ramakrishna Ashram Marg (Blue Line) or R.K. Ashram Marg; short auto ride to the temple.
  • By Bus/Auto: Well-connected by buses from Connaught Place and Karol Bagh.
  • By Car: Parking available nearby.

Entry Fee:

Free for all visitors.

Travel Tip: Visit around Diwali or Janmashtami for a truly vibrant and beautifully decorated temple experience.

faqs.question: Where is Birla Mandir located in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Birla Mandir is located on Mandir Marg, near Connaught Place, Delhi.

faqs.question: What is Birla Mandir famous for?
faqs.answer: It is famous for its modern architecture, grand festivals like Janmashtami and Diwali, and its peaceful spiritual atmosphere.

faqs.question: What are the timings of Birla Mandir Delhi?
faqs.answer: The temple is open daily from 4:30 AM to 1:30 PM and from 2:30 PM to 9:00 PM.

faqs.question: Which festivals are celebrated at Birla Mandir?
faqs.answer: The temple is most vibrant during Janmashtami and Diwali, attracting thousands of devotees.

faqs.question: How much time is needed to explore Birla Mandir?
faqs.answer: On average, 30 minutes to 1 hour is enough to explore the temple and its surroundings.
